messages:
Grace (AE): Hey team — we have a FortuneX POc kickoff next week. Sam (customer) asked for a POC that validates API latency/cost at scale and a security checklist. Primary asks: example prompts/evals, target latency, and a rough GPU/cost estimate for a 4-week POC. Can SE/infra help scope?

Sam (Customer): Our main use case is realtime summarization + a small follow-up Q&A (avg 150–250 tokens per call). Expect a bursty desktop load: 20–30 qps during peak 2-hour windows, baseline ~5 qps. Need data isolation and logs retained for 90 days for compliance.

Jamal (SE): Thanks Grace. Quick clarifying q: are we doing single-model baseline (Llama-2-70b q4) or comparing a cheaper quantized variant plus fallback? Also, do they need streaming?

Sam (Customer): Prefer single-model baseline we can ship fast, streaming would be nice but not required. Fallback for cost is optional.

Marta (Solutions): Suggest baseline with 13B quantized (for latency) and 70B q4 as comparison for quality. For POC success criteria: 1) p95 latency <= 300ms for single-turn, 2) avg response quality >= 85% on their eval set, 3) token cost <= $X/day (we'll estimate below), 4) end-to-end deploy/runbook validated.

Priya (Infra Eng): Draft capacity calc — using their profile: peak 30 qps, avg tokens 200 -> 6k tokens/s peak. With sequence length 200 and KV cache reuse low for summarization, estimate GPU throughput: A10G ~2k tokens/s, A100 ~8k tokens/s (approx). So for peak we need ~1 A100 or 3x A10G. For redundancy and canary: plan 2x A100 or 4x A10G.

Diego (Finance): Ballpark monthly POC cost (infra-only): A100 rented: ~$30/hr => 2x for HA = $1440/day => ~$43k/month. A10G: ~$6/hr x4 = $576/day => ~$17k/month. We should present both and frame as POC-week discounted.

Jamal (SE): For token cost: assume 2.5M tokens/day at peak profile. At hosted pricing equivalent (for customer understanding) that's ~ $0.005 per 1k tokens -> $12.5/day. But infra GPU dominates. Also consider batching: with 8-16 request batching we can improve token/s on A10G but increases tail latency. Recommend target p95 latency <=300ms as Marta suggested.

Leah (Security): Security notes — 90-day logs retention ok, they require KMS-backed keys and VPC peering. Private deployment needed if data residency enforced. We'll need their SOC2 attestation and IP allowlist. Add that to RACI and timeline.

Grace (AE): OK next steps: Jamal + Priya to produce a 1-page tech brief with expected p95/p50, GPU config options, and a cost table; Diego to provide POC pricing options (A100 vs A10G) and a recommended committed hours for 4-week POC discount; Leah to send security checklist to Sam by EOD. Can we hit a 48h turnaround?

Priya (Infra Eng): I'll drop a short calc in this thread in next 2 business hours.

Jamal (SE): I'll attach sample eval prompts and pass/fail thresholds. Example prompts (short):
```
1) Summarize article in <= 50 words. pass if ROUGE-L >= 0.55 vs gold
2) Answer follow-up Q w/ citation. pass if F1 >= 0.6 and cites source
```
I'll keep them simple for the POC.

Diego (Finance): For the proposal, we can offer a POC package: 4-week flat fee $12,000 (A10G cluster + support) or $28,000 (A100 HA + premium SLA). Those figures include infra + 2 dedicated SE hours/week. 

OpsBot (deploy-bot): Canary deploy checklist created: https://redwood.internal/canary-checks/poC-template — runbook template ID #POC-2026

Grace (AE): Thanks all. I'll loop in Sam and schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow to align prompts and timeline. If anyone has blockers (quota, infra lead time), flag here.

Sam (Customer): Thanks team — looking forward. One more ask: can you include perf testing against 99th percentile cold-start times? That will be a key risk for us.

Priya (Infra Eng): Good call. We'll include cold-start bench (container spinup + weights load) — expect ~45–120s on bare private infra depending on model size. We'll test and report.

Grace (AE): Perfect. Closing action items: Jamal: prompts + evals; Priya: capacity/cost calc + cold-start numbers; Diego: POC price options; Leah: security checklist; Marta: success criteria doc. 48h target. :thumbsup:
